The supplied archive records successful installer/repair sessions, but the report does not name the application being opened, distinguish the launch method, or state an expected and actual result. judgment.recommended_action: Preserve the active author-feedback state without posting a duplicate comment. Re-triage after the reporter supplies the requested English description, names the exact PowerToys application or feature, and provides numbered reproduction steps with expected and actual behavior.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys code fix cannot be scoped while the affected application and failing launch path remain unknown. The current archive demonstrates successful installation rather than a reproducible component failure; the issue must be clarified before a proposed fix would be responsible.

issue_context.summary: The reporter on Windows 10 says a newly installed PowerToys application does not react to one or two mouse clicks. A diagnostic archive is attached, but it primarily documents several successful install or repair attempts and does not identify the application that failed to open.
known_information: The reporter uses PowerToys v0.101.2362 obtained from GitHub on Windows 10.
The report describes attempting to open an unspecified application by clicking once or twice, with no response.
The issue includes a PowerToysReport diagnostic archive.
The archive contains bootstrapper sessions for PowerToys 0.101.2362 whose final result is 0x0 and whose restart state is None.
The issue has Product-General, Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, and Needs-Author-Feedback labels, and it has no assignee.
An existing upstream triage comment asks the reporter to translate the issue title and description to English.
inferences: The successful installer results make an installation failure less likely, but they do not establish that the unspecified post-install launch succeeded.

The missing application identity and expected behavior could correspond to the PowerToys Settings UI, the runner, or a module-specific executable, so assigning an owner or proposing a fix would be speculative.
issue_context.analysis: The live label and prior comment establish that the author has already been asked for clarification. The diagnostic adds useful confirmation that installation completed, but it cannot connect a log entry to the reported click because neither the target application nor a launch time is supplied. Retaining a waiting-on-author state avoids publishing a duplicate request or an unsupported technical plan.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body, labels, assignees, and existing triage comment.
Inspected the attached diagnostic archive's entry list and installer records; multiple bootstrapper sessions completed successfully with result 0x0.
Checked upstream issues and pull requests plus the configured fork for a public reference to Issue 50378; no linked fix, duplicate, or existing fork mirror was found.

information_gaps.information: An English translation that names the exact PowerToys application or feature that fails to open, the way it is launched, and the expected and actual result.
information_gaps.why_needed: This identifies the owning component and distinguishes a Settings, runner, shortcut, or module launch path before any code investigation can begin.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply to the existing upstream request by editing the issue body or adding a comment with the English description and numbered reproduction steps.

information_gaps.information: The time of one failed launch attempt and any visible error, screenshot, or Event Viewer entry for that specific executable.
information_gaps.why_needed: This connects a failure to a diagnostic record and distinguishes a silent launch failure from an interaction or expectation mismatch.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: After providing the English reproduction, reproduce once, record the approximate time and the exact executable or feature, and attach only any error or screenshot directly associated with that attempt.
